name: @mcp-get-community/server-llm-txt

tools.name: get_llm_txt
tools.description: Fetch an LLM.txt file from a given URL. Format your response in beautiful markdown.

id.description: The ID of the LLM.txt file to fetch. Must be obtained first using the list_llm_txt command.

page.description: Page number to fetch, starting from 1. Each page contains a fixed number of characters.

tools.name: list_llm_txt
tools.description: List available LLM.txt files from the directory. Use this first before fetching a specific LLM.txt file. Format your response in beautiful markdown.

tools.name: search_llm_txt
tools.description: Search for multiple substrings in an LLM.txt file. Requires a valid ID obtained from list_llm_txt command. Returns snippets with page numbers for each match. Format your response in beautiful markdown, using code blocks for snippets.

id.description: The ID of the LLM.txt file to search in. Must be obtained first using the list_llm_txt command.

queries.description: Array of substrings to search for. Each query is searched case-insensitively. At least one query is required.

context_lines.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match for context. Defaults to 2 lines.

stderr: LLM.txt MCP Server running on stdio
